Mets name Andy Green full-time manager, win first game

The New York Mets have named Andy Green as their full-time manager, signing him to a three-year deal and foregoing an external search. The team won its first game under Green, defeating the AL West-leading Texas Rangers 6-3. The hiring and game result were reported by multiple outlets.
